economic_hypothesis: During a causally known broad BULL market, an industry whose twenty-session trend remains positive but whose five-session median return fell below -3% can offer a rotation entry when at least 65% of its members turn positive and its daily median return exceeds 1%. Stocks with intact medium-term strength and demand confirmation carry that repair.
entry: first legal next daily open within three market sessions
exit: target or causal H5/H10/H15 decision then next legal open

industry.pullback: previous completed industry median five-session return<=-3%
industry.repair: current median daily return>=1%, positive share>=65%, median5 improving
industry.trend: PIT ret20 percentile>=60% and median ret20>0

market.BEAR: both medians <= 0 AND both positive-return shares <= 0.50
market.BULL: market median ret20 > 0 AND positive-ret20 share > 0.50 AND market median ret60 > 0 AND positive-ret60 share > 0.50
market.TRANSITION: all other combinations or missing required state
market.strategy_action: trade only BULL; BEAR and TRANSITION hold cash

rules.R3_LEADING_INDUSTRY_REPAIR: R1 and PIT industry ret20 percentile>=70%

stock: prior ret20>=0, prior ret60>=10%, daily return>=2%, close location>=70%, turnover>=prior20 mean
